title: Pokemon TCG Korean Gyarados 130/165 Holo Rare Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and sought-after Pokémon card features the beloved Gyarados character in stunning holo detail. It is from the Scarlet & Violet - 151 set, manufactured by Nintendo for the Pokémon Trading Card Game. The card is a Stage 2 Pokémon type, with a card number of 151 and a finish of Reverse Holo.

The card is in standard size and has a beautiful illustration of Gyarados. It is suitable for collectors of all ages, but is recommended for those over 6 years old. This card is a must-have for any serious Pokémon card collector and is sure to be a valuable addition to your collection.
